scope: node; shared module; not browser heap, not network
method: Each scenario runs in a fresh child process (node --expose-gc). Uses createPrintTransfer + createPrintOperations (same modules the browser/MCP use): beginImport, 64 KiB base64 write chunks, SHA-256 verified commit (parse), beginExport, 64 KiB read chunks, SHA-256 and project-revision comparison. heapUsed high-water is sampled by a 2 ms timer and at phase/chunk boundaries (a lower bound; synchronous parser spans are not sampled). peakRssBytes is the OS process high-water (process.resourceUsage().maxRSS) and includes payload generation.
